title: Biggest sales by Bundesliga clubs
brief: Name the ten players sold by Bundesliga clubs for the biggest fees since July 2000, ranked by the guaranteed fee in euros reported at the time.
period: Transfers from July 2000 to the end of the summer 2026 window (1 September 2026). Ranked by the guaranteed fee in euros as reported at the time; add-ons are left out. A loan with an obligation to buy counts at the obligation fee.

notes.Kevin De Bruyne: Kevin De Bruyne is 11th, just outside: Wolfsburg to Manchester City in 2015, about £55m (German reports €74m, rising to €80m; TM €76m).
notes.Nick Woltemade: Nick Woltemade is 11th equal, just outside: Stuttgart to Newcastle in 2025, £64.8m (€75m) plus €5m add-ons.
notes.Omar Marmoush: Omar Marmoush is outside the ten: Eintracht Frankfurt to Manchester City in 2025, TM €75m including add-ons.
notes.Dominik Szoboszlai: Dominik Szoboszlai is outside the ten: €70m release clause, RB Leipzig to Liverpool in 2023.
notes.Erling Haaland: Erling Haaland is outside the ten: €60m release clause, Dortmund to Manchester City in 2022.
notes.Leroy Sane: Leroy Sane is outside the ten: Schalke to Manchester City in 2016, about €50m.

checks: Every fee was read from Transfermarkt's club or league record page and checked against a news report (BBC, Sky, Reuters, AP, ESPN, the Guardian, Eurosport, kicker, Calcio e Finanza, A Bola or the club's statement, as named per row in transfers.csv). Where a report splits a fee into a fixed part and add-ons, the fixed part is used, so several fees are lower than Transfermarkt's (which usually adds add-ons paid or agency costs). Where a player went the other way as part of the fee, only the cash is counted unless the clubs stated a fee for each player (Arthur and Pjanic, Cancelo and Danilo, Cillessen and Neto).
